name: long vambraces
_design_note: F40-80 medium-heavy arms slot. Articulated forearm plate with flared wrist guard. Bridge between iron_vambraces and plate_vambraces.
lore_template: A pair of long {material_name} vambraces, hinged at the elbow, with a flared cup at the wrist made to catch a blade and steer it wide. The flare turns a parry into an opening.
